opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, and enrolled in an eligible undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution (including specific universities, Glasgow School of Art, Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, SRUC). Applicants must be UK residents (including asylum seekers) and meet income thresholds.
opportunities.summary: Grants to cover tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland for academic year 2026‑27.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Graduates from low‑income Scottish households who wish to undertake a full‑time Master's programme (up to two years) at a Scottish university. Applicants must meet income thresholds and be eligible for UK residency.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support postgraduate Master's study for graduates from low‑income Scottish households.
